scope: Required quest-state load and consistent header/term reads before character admission. Functional integrity repair; no quest reward, balance or chart changes.
implemented: Quest progression is loaded through IQuestProgressStore before publishing ClientSession.Char. SQL/IO/format/cancellation failures propagate instead of creating a playable empty log; a valid empty result is still accepted for a new character.

Client CS_CONNECT_REQ and world MW_ENTERSVR_REQ share load-failure handling: clear main/validated state, remove the registry entry, return the existing Internal result and close the session. Queued handshake packets cannot promote the rejected session.

Successful login reconstructs saved completions, running terms and failed timers before world/client character packets. The world follow-up reuses the already loaded character rather than loading quests twice.

LoadQuestsAsync reads headers and terms under one serializable SQL transaction. Existing SaveQuestsAsync header/term transactions and journal barriers are retained. An incomplete query/cancellation returns no partial log; disposing the transaction releases its locks.

history_review.reason: The old catch logged quest-progress load failure and continued with an empty log. A positive-control regression demonstrates that losing the saved completion makes the same valid accept/turn-in packets pay the reward again. Independent autocommit SELECTs could read a header before a concurrent save and terms after it.
history_review.preserved: Existing entry validation, security-code handling, main/DB-loaded save gates, valid empty-character entry, quest CountMax, reward validation, timer semantics, journal FIFO and native packet sequence.

post_child_recovery: The current 35 SendPost charts have no TT_EXECQUEST children, so no new gameplay rule or generic event replay was introduced. Recovery of arbitrary future/other child graphs remains an implementation gap; uncapped original events still lack durable identity.
remaining: Real-client login failure/retry, logout/relog, quest rewards and full game-server restart remain acceptance requirements. These tests do not certify Gameforge data or the selected client release.
Full native character/global/pet/companion save recovery and cross-Map character ownership fencing remain as listed in Gameforge/quest-save-recovery.json.

Required auxiliary state (companions/medals, mounts, recalls, hotkeys, allegiance and owned timed items) now also denies admission on read failure. See Gameforge/character-admission.json; complete native save/restart and distributed persistence acceptance remains open.
RT_SOUL and TT_WARREGION reference gaps and generic post-reservation child-event recovery remain open. No chart counters, rewards, probabilities or trigger rules were changed.
